name: Safety Bar Squat
instructions: Set the safety squat bar on your upper back, holding the front handles.
Unrack and take your squat stance.
Descend with control, staying more upright than a straight-bar squat allows.
Drive through the whole foot to stand. The cambered bar is gentler on the shoulders.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: An intermediate safety-bar squat-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Safety Bar Squat develops leg strength through a full range of motion, which carries straight into daily life.
